from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class RDExpense(BaseModel):
    """A single R&D expense data point from one quarterly report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name, e.g. '洋河股份'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g. '2021 Q1', '2022 Q1'")
    rd_expense: float | None = Field(description="R&D expense amount in yuan")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. 'yuan'")
    yoy_change_rate: float | None = Field(description="Year-over-year change rate percentage, if reported")
    yoy_amount: float | None = Field(description="Previous year's same quarter amount for comparison, if reported")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the report containing the R&D data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    rd_expenses: List[RDExpense]
